economy.zh:
今日经济新闻聚焦地缘政治缓和与贸易摩擦交织：美伊谈判取得重大进展推动油价回落，但中美博弈再度升级——中国针对美国国防部黑名单实施贸易反制；港股在科技股拖累下逼近熊市，A股则放量成交破3万亿，结构性行情分化明显。欧洲方面，市场消化美联储鹰派信号后普遍走弱，能源安全担忧与英国脱欧十周年的经济反思成为焦点。同花顺社区题材炒作活跃，银之杰因散户大神出任董事长涨停，金刚石散热概念崛起。

- [U.S., Iran agree on roadmap for final deal and plan to end military operations in Lebanon](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/22/us-iran-roadmap-final-deal-switzerland-talks-lebanon-deconfliction.html) — 美伊在瑞士达成60天路线图，油价应声下跌，但特朗普同时威胁对伊朗采取军事行动，前景仍存变数。
- [China imposes trade curbs on dozens of U.S. firms in retaliation for Pentagon blacklist](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/22/china-trade-curbs-us-companies-export-controls-procurement-exclusion-pentagon-list-.html) — 中国对数十家美国企业实施出口管制和采购限制，作为对五角大楼1260H清单的报复，科技脱钩进一步深化。
- [Chinese Stocks in Hong Kong Near Bear Market After Holiday](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPay1kbHlGWGZtRC1vMFViS0dJRlVwZ0NXNnNGZm5pbGxYemRhd2lSSVl6YlkwMHFaZ2dKc1U0ZU53cEdHdzZWTl9mSnRoTEFhVWUtS201YUxWWWxfVUlpOGdfWllLREQzNGdQRmg1R3ZvMEJ1SHdKU0F6UUNiU0NNbmlxanNVNGVXOTJ2enI5SkRfekJ5YUVNbTF0cjZUbVIwNzVrcVlRVlEyMkFGcEE) — 恒生指数在阿里、小米领跌下逼近技术性熊市，市场对中美关系及经济复苏力度担忧加剧。
- [Zhipu AI market cap tops HK$1 trillion as shares of GLM-5.2 developer soar](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3357858/zhipu-ai-market-cap-tops-hk1-trillion-shares-glm-52-developer-soar) — 智谱AI港股一度飙涨42%，市值突破万亿港元，成为AI赛道新焦点。
- [European shares retreat as markets mull hawkish US Federal Reserve](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNODYwMzJGal94alJkSHIyVkNNMnlqVlo3OGYzNjZNOV9qM0lGdmNzQ0lBTUZuMFlaSGJvMFNSLUtBR25DUWE5clhNTnVNSjFPYVpTWGg3LTItdlREa1ZtYXE3Sm5lT2tjZXNkR1RENUp2dWxMU2RNOG14Q1FtSHR0dlVB) — 欧洲股市回落，市场重新评估美联储紧缩路径对全球流动性的影响。
- [散户大神出任董事长，银之杰20cm涨停，封单超8万手](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9fX0pQZnVyME1PSnhzaXY4Q203OWJQZUswbm82U1BTVlJqUV9feWxtY1FJblgxM3VvMkkwNVptTFRnUjlPSl9RY1RLMy14TXlBLXdyNVFnYmdxYXQxdWc) — A股社区情绪高涨，银之杰因散户投资者出任董事长封死涨停，带动低价股炒作热情。

**后续观察**：关注本周美联储PCE通胀数据与FedEx财报对美股方向的指引；中美贸易反制是否触发新一轮科技供应链调整；港股能否在政策利好（如支持外资上市、跨境通道扩展）下止跌；欧洲能源价格走势及德国经济改革讨论对市场信心的影响。
economy.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by geopolitical crosscurrents and diverging market signals. A potential U.S.-Iran détente sent oil prices tumbling while the Nikkei surged to a record high, yet European and U.S. futures slipped. China retaliated against Pentagon blacklists with new trade curbs, and its onshore and Hong Kong markets showed strain. Meanwhile, the AI race continued to drive valuations, and the Fed's quiet revolution under Kevin Warsh began to take shape. Here are the key developments:

- **Oil slides on U.S.-Iran roadmap**: Crude prices fell after Qatar and Pakistan announced a 60-day roadmap for a final U.S.-Iran deal. Iran’s foreign minister cited “major progress” toward ending hostilities in Lebanon ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/22/oil-prices-wti-brent-crude-trump-iran-threat-strait-hormuz-closure.html); [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/22/business/oil-gas-price-iran.html)). The agreement also includes deconfliction in Lebanon, reducing a key geopolitical risk premium.
- **China imposes trade curbs on U.S. firms**: In retaliation for the Pentagon’s updated 1260H list, Beijing placed export controls and procurement bans on dozens of U.S. companies. The move escalates the technology decoupling and adds headwinds for global supply chains ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/22/china-trade-curbs-us-companies-export-controls-procurement-exclusion-pentagon-list-.html)).
- **Hong Kong and China stocks near bear market**: The Hang Seng index approached correction territory as Alibaba and Xiaomi dragged the gauge lower. A-share turnover exceeded 3 trillion yuan, suggesting both panic and opportunity ([Bloomberg](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPay1kbHlGWGZtRC1vMFViS0dJRlVwZ0NXNnNGZm5pbGxYemRhd2lSSVl6YlkwMHFaZ2dKc1U0ZU53cEdHdzZWTl9mSnRoTEFhVWUtS201YUxWWWxfVUlpOGdfWllLREQzNGdQRmg1R3ZvMEJ1SHdKU0F6UUNiU0NNbmlxanNVNGVXOTJ2enI5SkRfekJ5YUVNbTF0cjZUbVIwNzVrcVlRVlEyMkFGcEE)).
- **Zhipu AI market cap tops HK$1 trillion**: The Hong Kong-listed AI company surged up to 42% on investor enthusiasm for its GLM-5.2 model, rivalling U.S. AI giants ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3357858/zhipu-ai-market-cap-tops-hk1-trillion-shares-glm-52-developer-soar)).
- **Fed's Warsh begins quiet revolution**: Kevin Warsh has set up task forces to rethink Fed operations, signaling a “velvet glove” regime change. Market participants are watching for implications on the rate path ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/21/how-kevin-warsh-has-set-out-to-remake-the-fed.html)).
- **European shares retreat on hawkish Fed**: The Stoxx 600 fell as markets weighed the Fed’s tighter stance. Barclays warned that hawkish central banks could challenge equity momentum ([AOL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNODYwMzJGal94alJkSHIyVkNNMnlqVlo3OGYzNjZNOV9qM0lGdmNzQ0lBTUZuMFlaSGJvMFNSLUtBR25DUWE5clhNTnVNSjFPYVpTWGg3LTItdlREa1ZtYXE3Sm5lT2tjZXNkR1RENUp2dWxMU2RNOG14Q1FtSHR0dlVB); [Yahoo Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxObS05N1BNOXpRWlZKbC1BemNiUTVDUTd4ZzFnTDlYekhlWUhRY0F0OVRlNWIzR3N4b1p0cDIyY29xUzdoS3FyR05VeHRqeUExa3p2SjdpNVVHUF9qbFpNbnROS1JBeTFmaDV2WWNXSXo3MmstSHpVVzUwb3ViakU3aERfRHplcldQQzhkSHJpT0hmNU5pdlZGNUpUMElocDZOcGVF)).
- **Retail investors in China cheer diamond heat-sink concept**: On Tonghuashun, stocks tied to diamond-based thermal materials surged, reflecting the chase for new AI-related themes. The “retail investor god” story of Yinzhijie’s 20% limit-up captured attention ([Tonghuashun](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9fX0pQZnVyME1PSnhzaXY4Q203OWJQZUswbm82U1BTVlJqUV9feWxtY1FJblgxM3VvMkkwNVptTFRnUjlPSl9RY1RLMy14TXlBLXdyNVFnYmdxYXQxdWc)).

**Watch next**: All eyes will be on the official U.S.-Iran negotiations this week, the Fed’s preferred PCE inflation gauge (due Friday), and FedEx earnings as a bellwether for global trade. In China, the backdrop of retaliatory trade curbs and a weakening yuan could accelerate capital outflows or spur stimulus hopes.

society.zh: 今日社会新闻呈现三大焦点：**俄乌冲突战术升级**、**哥伦比亚选举转向强硬路线**、以及**亚洲多国旅游政策剧烈调整**。俄军集结重兵威胁顿涅茨克关键城市科斯强季尼夫卡，一旦失守乌东防线将面临崩溃；乌克兰无人机反击导致克里米亚汽油停售，凸显战争对民用基础设施的连锁冲击。哥伦比亚总统决选中，特朗普支持的局外人埃斯普里耶拉以微弱优势领先，其承诺恢复全面军事对抗可能改写该国和平进程。亚洲方面，日本从7月起签证费暴涨5倍，韩国、泰国等则通过数字游民签证争夺远程工作者，区域旅游格局出现分化。此外，澳大利亚楼市创六年新低、法国高温红色警报下禁酒、澳洲查获史上最大可卡因案等本地新闻也值得关注。中国方面，人工智能加速渗透“情绪经济”赛道，教育公司集体布局AI短剧培训，反映技术对消费与就业结构的深层影响。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by escalating geopolitical conflicts, domestic social disruptions, and emerging tech trends. In Eastern Europe, Russian forces threaten a key Ukrainian city; in Latin America, Colombia moves toward a hardline military approach; and transatlantic tensions rise as China retaliates against US sanctions. Domestically, Australia's housing market hits a six-year low, France faces extreme heat, and BTS fans fall prey to ticket scams. Meanwhile, AI is reshaping China's 'emotional economy', and Japan-Korea relations show cautious progress.

- **Ukraine war intensifies**: Russian troop buildup near Kostyantynivka endangers Ukraine's last eastern strongholds. Fuel shortages in Crimea after strikes ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9w2g0ewk95o)).
- **Colombia votes for change**: Trump-backed outsider Abelardo de la Espriella wins runoff, promising full-scale military confrontation with armed groups ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/21/colombias-runoff-election-expected-to-trigger-shift-in-decades-long-armed-conflict)).
- **US-China trade war escalates**: China sanctions 10 American defense firms in response to US restrictions on Chinese tech exports ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/22/nx-s1-5866202/china-sanctions-restricting-exports)).
- **France under red heat alert**: Half of France faces record temperatures; alcohol banned at street music festival ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgmdw4vn7y2o)).
- **Australian housing crisis deepens**: Clearance rates fall to 47.4%, lowest since April 2020 ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/jun/22/auction-clearance-rates-six-year-low-australian-homes)).
- **BTS ticket scams surge**: Demand-supply ratio of 15:1 makes desperate fans easy targets for fraudsters ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdr45nrr2jyo)).
- **AI fuels China's 'emotional economy'**: New applications target sentiment analysis and personalized engagement ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPT3NMM014Si1sWW1MOF9ocGd1cEc1TFU4RjhXWDZWcEN3ZDNvQmF0b0V5ZmlfQzBRN1RmODdkdEliNFBwcmktSG5ISHFfckZOdkpCakNDQ25Zd1NlWkJKdXRBaGI0aDFLMXlnZ1dUdk0xeW42TnpZS1RWQWdjLWpmMzlsdk9LOVVH)).
- **Japan-South Korea detente persists but no breakthrough**: Ties deepen 61 years after normalization treaty, but key issues remain ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNR20zRXRjbFZtLURDY1ZkVlU2ejZWa3pGbVlHWERBVFpRelVjRXFUcjRaUy1Kc2hXYzUwd2VOWDAxQWYweGppWlJseTM0YXVzTVBhaHRKQV84aTY4dUkwZUNBUFM4bXNMZkdnZ09PcXBER1RhQUFKaHVaWl9sOU1tSHFaTFlSSWhwdGNr)).

**Watch next**: Monitor Colombia's transition and security situation, Ukrainian frontline movements, US-Iran talks progress, and China's AI policy rollout.

military.zh:
## 军事新闻板块 · 2026-06-22

过去24小时，全球军事态势呈现多重升级信号。在印太方向，中美导弹威慑博弈进一步白热化——中国官方媒体首次公开DF-17高超音速导弹发射画面，而美军将Typhon中程导弹系统部署至日本，首次将第一岛链打击能力推向实战化。乌克兰战场方面，俄方称乌军无人机袭击在克里米亚和克拉斯诺达尔造成5人死亡，克里米亚暂停公共燃料销售，显示乌军持续打击俄后勤链。伊朗方向，美伊签署60天谅解备忘录后美国解除对伊朗海军封锁，但五角大楼要求追加800亿美元用于伊朗战争及其他开支，显示冲突成本与外交进程并行。此外，美海军陆战队在冲绳强化濒海团反舰与防空能力，巴基斯坦试射Taimoor巡航导弹改变南亚空中力量平衡，中国将10家美国涉军实体列入出口管制名单——多个热点同步升温，牵动全球安全格局。

- [1580 Days of russia-Ukraine War – russian Casualties in Ukraine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQdzNGcE5wM1pHRjdkX2swNU1QWjFWdmFSN3JVbEh6S0FHdzlBWWJGNHJMY2xZNXRMUnc0TTltY3UwcUtiVjVQTDhYZzFFNWhQMkxZeEdtckk1ak9kVTJoLWdEU3Nwdm5YUHJuWFJ5YV9sYmIyT1pvenpjRlI0ZzlHVGhVMk5Kem5oeTFMZEhmYnVDNEFYVmNRd2tha0s1WG8tTGdDbUdn) — 俄乌战争进入第1580天，俄军伤亡统计持续攀升。
- [中国官方媒体首次公开DF-17高超音速导弹发射画面](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBIbzlEaGFhTkx0MS10aFRfS05zaDV6ZlpYb1RORE8yODV6NC1GVGZEMmJSWnRzZUZfenVBOHN1amZTVVpDMXlhNVhOb1ZmY25MQkFweWpjQTJtTnhzakdUdFVB) — 这是中国首次展示具备高机动突防能力的战役级武器。
- [美军将Typhon中程导弹系统部署至日本](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxORjUzV20xbWJ0RVhfd2dUVXFKc0E0Vk9jT1JVb01qQlJFcGxfYjkzcm0wTmVnazRtazR4QUxEbXIxWUJwQmRza1pyR2lFRmJJTUl6OS1TeUVraG9NR054RXdSTEp1emtEZThqNlFSLTc1OEY2UnFYMEdvREo4SjNmOHBJTzFFSndXMUZQZ2ZZQnp1X1RURmdPSTNuckdOWUsyQS1zQ3Q5dGs1bjdP) — 此举直接扩大第一岛链内对华威慑，印太紧张显著升级。
- [巴基斯坦Taimoor巡航导弹威胁印度空军基地和航母战斗群](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxONFJVYVpGUmRZNWtSd2ppT2l4ZlhpNnVKUkdmaHU4OUFDTlowNVU5N3dnbzBUQk9CNjFadGpfYWJCMjdPSktKSDZ1d3dzeFhQZFl4Z18yX0JHdjB5dVZqNG9sSWt0NjA2MUtjVllJX0VkTE1RRTV5a2pnaTBONXdIc1d1T1l0YUlKNHE4REFnNnpoNWtPTzZoNC1pcUppcDl1QTROeTNfTUNzZGFXUmtGWlNZQXh0WTlCdXVV) — 改变南亚空中力量平衡，JF-17搭载深打击能力。
- [美国解除对伊朗海上封锁](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-ends-naval-blockade-of-iran) — 美伊签署60天谅解备忘录，但美军资产继续留在中东以确保落实。
- [美海军陆战队在冲绳强化濒海团：部署NMESIS反舰系统和MADIS防空系统](https://news.google.) — 提升反舰与对空防御，针对性强化对台海冲突的干预能力。
- [五角大楼要求追加800亿美元用于伊朗战争及其他开支](https://www.defensenews.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/06/19/pentagon-tells-lawmakers-it-needs-80-billion-for-iran-war-other-expenses-wsj/) — 冲突成本仍属未知，国会态度是关键变量。

**后续观察**：印太方向导弹部署竞赛正在加速，DF-17与Typhon形成直接对抗；乌克兰无人机作战持续暴露俄防御缺口，但俄方反制手段未见效；美伊外交看似缓和，但追加军费与解除封锁之间的张力可能随时迸发。建议重点关注6月24日开始的环太平洋演习（RIMPAC 2026）对各方兵力调动的信号效应。
military.en:
The global military landscape is marked by rapid technological escalation and strategic repositioning, with hypersonic and precision-strike systems reshaping deterrence from the Indo-Pacific to the Black Sea. The U.S. and Iran have moved from open hostilities to a 60-day ceasefire and lifted naval blockade, yet force postures remain high with new missile deployments to Japan and ongoing counter-drug strikes. Meanwhile, China showcases its DF-17 and integrates AEW&C with destroyers, while Russia-Ukraine drone warfare continues to inflict casualties and disrupt logistics. This brief highlights the convergence of advanced weapons, forward basing, and diplomatic maneuvering that defines the current security environment.

- **U.S.-Iran De-escalation:** The U.S. lifted its naval blockade of Iran under a 60-day MOU, but CENTCOM retains naval assets in the region ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-ends-naval-blockade-of-iran)). The Pentagon separately requested $80 billion for the Iran war and other expenses ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/06/19/pentagon-tells-lawmakers-it-needs-80-billion-for-iran-war-other-expenses-wsj/)).
- **Missile Competition in Indo-Pacific:** The U.S. deployed the Typhon mid-range missile system to Japan, escalating deterrence against China ([Defence Security Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxORjUzV20xbWJ0RVhfd2dUVXFKc0E0Vk9jT1JVb01qQlJFcGxfYjkzcm0wTmVnazRtazR4QUxEbXIxWUJwQmRza1pyR2lFRmJJTUl6OS1TeUVraG9NR054RXdSTEp1emtEZThqNlFSLTc1OEY2UnFYMEdvREo4SjNmOHBJTzFFSndXMUZQZ2ZZQnp1X1RURmdPSTNuckdOWUsyQS1zQ3Q5dGs1bjdP)). China's official media showcased the DF-17 hypersonic missile for the first time ([Global Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBIbzlEaGFhTkx0MS10aFRfS05zaDV6ZlpYb1RORE8yODV6NC1GVGZEMmJSWnRzZUZfenVBOHN1amZTVVpDMXlhNVhOb1ZmY25MQkFweWpjQTJtTnhzakdUdFVB)).
- **China Boosts Naval Targeting:** Integration of Type 055 destroyers with AEW&C 'flying radars' significantly improves over-the-horizon targeting ([Military Watch Magazine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxQeXliSk5ScGhBZllmWWE0N05xblk1ZWw5anB1LTY5YTllZmZabnlyTjBQOTI3Q25QX1RDZXFxLUt1cjdyWEFOZ2pQaFZmN3ZUTU9VekFVTmo0RDI5R3doM1AyRVJwYk15blYxTjNoYll6eDV6MXpLSGtTWUhILWtqdEhmcURWQ3NGU0FYRTl3)).
- **Ukraine War – Drone Strikes Deepen:** Ukrainian drone attacks killed five in Crimea and Krasnodar, prompting Crimea to halt public fuel sales ([Al Arabiya English](https://news.google.)). Kyiv Post reports Iran 'endured' one specific target the U.S. didn't hit ([Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE51bXdOdmhlRG9lREFQNlZ6R2h5bkU0dUF2YjktUUZhMFhWa3BRZXlIRWhQWlRmLVByOTZ0Z0ZxcUZ3QnVxLVJja1kxcW0yOHc)).
- **Army’s New Drone Unit:** The 7th Infantry Division Multi-Domain Command – Pacific aims to 'overwhelm' adversaries with drones in a Pacific fight ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/armys-newest-unit-wants-to-overwhelm-adversaries-with-drones-in-pacific-fight)).
- **Pakistan’s Taimoor Cruise Missile:** Pakistan’s deep-strike capability from JF-17s threatens Indian air bases and carrier groups, redrawing South Asia’s airpower balance ([Defence Security Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxONFJVYVpGUmRZNWtSd2ppT2l4ZlhpNnVKUkdmaHU4OUFDTlowNVU5N3dnbzBUQk9CNjFadGpfYWJCMjdPSktKSDZ1d3dzeFhQZFl4Z18yX0JHdjB5dVZqNG9sSWt0NjA2MUtjVllJX0VkTE1RRTV5a2pnaTBONXdIc1d1T1l0YUlKNHE4REFnNnpoNWtPTzZoNC1pcUppcDl1QTROeTNfTUNzZGFXUmtGWlNZQXh0WTlCdXVV)).
- **China Blacklists 10 U.S. Entities:** China added 10 U.S. military-related entities to an export control list, retaliating amid tech tensions ([chinanews.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFBrbUlJRGVKWWtPckNxSUhXYTFsOGsxaW1CUWFDZ2FqbDNxVTh5MnpLbHlkZ1lFNjhoVDkwR21KalZ1QV9DWDZWOEZJY2E4UWluVXJiTFlCUW9WbXY4YmdlOG1DT2FRVlRs)).

**Watch next:** The RIMPAC 2026 exercise beginning June 24 will gather dozens of allied navies in Hawaii, offering a real-time test of interoperability against hypersonic and drone threats. Concurrently, US-Iran nuclear talks in Switzerland could either solidify the ceasefire or collapse into renewed strikes. Monitor the Pentagon’s $80 billion supplemental request for implications on defense industrial base capacity.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现出三条主线：AI顶尖人才加速向Anthropic聚集，预测市场平台Polymarket深陷造假丑闻，电动汽车在赛事与商用领域全面提速。以下为值得关注的动态：

- **AI人才战白热化**：继诺贝尔奖得主之后，[AlphaFold创始人John Jumper](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPdmdSeWhpLW1rX0RZSVRwNFdTeTJrdG10dVd6Z1pSa3JOdE9pWUQwX1dOdmE2cENHRm5LYURWVTc0V1llRDI3OVYwWFlKemJ6d3dFWEQ0SEpTLVpLZHZ2UUV2c2hsWXpjekJBZ2loZkp3bzh3UGg3U2pscWQtVUJ2QUhoWkM0RnF6d0k1NzlrOFRxSXlsOWNfWWdJQm8)也离开Google DeepMind加入Anthropic，36氪将此解读为“谷歌内部信仰动摇”。
- **Polymarket造假风波**：《华尔街日报》调查发现，[Polymarket付费创作者制作虚假投注视频](https://www.engadget.com/2198495/wall-street-journal-polymarket-reportedly-paying-creators-to-post-fake-betting-videos/)，涉及1100余条剪辑，平台使用“近乎完美的克隆网站”拍摄，Engadget、TechCrunch、The Verge均跟进报道。
- **电动赛车复仇成功**：福特[Super Mustang Mach-E在派克峰爬山赛](https://electrek.co/2026/06/21/electric-cars-win-at-pikes-peak-as-the-super-mustang-mach-e-gets-its-revenge/)击败所有燃油车夺冠，总成绩第一，扭转去年惜败局面。
- **传统摩托巨头电动化**：Royal Enfield旗下Flying Flea品牌[首款电动摩托车FF.C6在印度交付](https://electrek.co/2026/06/21/the-wait-is-over-royal-enfields-first-electric-motorcycle-begins-deliveries/)，标志百年品牌正式入局电动两轮。
- **爱沙尼亚为AI代理发“身份证”**：该国计划成为[首个为AI代理发放数字身份代码的国家](https://news.err.ee/1610060290/estonia-to-become-first-country-to-issue-id-codes-to-ai-agents)，在监管沙盒中探索自主代理的法律主体地位。
- **Airbnb CEO转战AI**：据Bloomberg报道，[Brian Chesky计划创立一家新AI公司](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-06-04/airbnb-ceo-brian-chesky-plans-to-start-a-new-ai-company)，不过消息源为6月初，今日被Hacker News重新推送引发讨论。
- **社区爆文质疑“欺诈性就业”**：一篇[“我的旧工作是否只因为欺诈而存在”](https://david.newgas.net/did-my-old-job-only-exist-because-of-fraud/)的帖子在Hacker News获434分，作者复盘前公司虚构收入指标的过程，引发对科技公司“伪增长”的反思。
- **中国钠电池重卡上路测试**：一汽解放与合作伙伴[在商用车上试验钠离子电池](https://electrek.co/2026/06/21/from-labs-to-logistics-china-tests-sodium-batteries-in-hd-trucks/)，若成功将大幅降低电动重卡成本。

**后续观察**：Anthropic正在成为AI人才黑洞，谷歌DeepMind的动摇可能影响其长期竞争力；Polymarket的诚信危机将对整个预测市场赛道产生连锁监管压力；电动汽车在极端场景（赛事、矿山）的胜利逐步打消用户续航焦虑。
tech.en:
The last 24 hours in tech were dominated by a major scandal at Polymarket, a tragic loss for Ubisoft, and a seismic talent shift in AI as AlphaFold's creator left DeepMind for Anthropic. Meanwhile, electric vehicles continue to crush it at Pikes Peak, Estonia moves to give AI agents legal IDs, and the Hacker News community is buzzing over a Danish privacy activist's police raid and a huge FDA vote on mRNA. Here are the headlines that matter most.

- **[Polymarket has reportedly been paying creators to post fake betting videos](https://www.engadget.com/2198495/wall-street-journal-polymarket-reportedly-paying-creators-to-post-fake-betting-videos/)** — The WSJ uncovered over 1,100 deceptive clips on near-perfect copies of the site. The company paid creators to fake wins, raising serious questions about platform integrity and potential regulatory fallout. (Also covered by [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/21/polymarket-reportedly-paid-creators-to-post-deceptive-videos-about-fake-bets/) and [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/953285/polymarket-fake-viral-video-bets))
- **[Ubisoft co-founder Claude Guillemot dies in plane crash](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/21/ubisoft-co-founder-claude-guillemot-dies-in-plane-crash/)** — The 69-year-old who co-founded one of gaming's biggest publishers has died, sending shockwaves through the industry.
- **[AlphaFold creator John Jumper leaves Google DeepMind for Anthropic](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPdmdSeWhpLW1rX0RZSVRwNFdTeTJrdG10dVd6Z1pSa3JOdE9pWUQwX1dOdmE2cENHRm5LYURWVTc0V1llRDI3OVYwWFlKemJ6d3dFWEQ0SEpTLVpLZHZ2UUV2c2hsWXpjekJBZ2loZkp3bzh3UGg3U2pscWQtVUJ2QUhoWkM0RnF6d0k1NzlrOFRxSXlsOWNfWWdJQm8)** — A Nobel-worthy scientist hops to Anthropic, adding to a 48-hour exodus of top talent from Google. (See also [36Kr](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTFAtMXl1Y0NjcWFfSlg5eW1CWjlBdDZOUlU1czVOU04xTXptOGRDRzdIc2J4YWV5dVdVM0t0eE5Ua0VjSFpIaTNSd0xLalBnVDVDd0dZ))
- **[Estonia to become first country to create digital identities for AI agents](https://news.err.ee/1610060290/estonia-to-become-first-country-to-issue-id-codes-to-ai-agents)** — A groundbreaking legal framework that could redefine how autonomous agents operate and interact.
- **[Electric cars win again at Pike’s Peak as Super Mustang Mach-E gets its revenge](https://electrek.co/2026/06/21/electric-cars-win-at-pikes-peak-as-the-super-mustang-mach-e-gets-its-revenge/)** — Ford’s EV beat every gas car up the hill, underscoring the accelerating performance gap in motorsports.
- **[Deno Desktop](https://docs.deno.com/runtime/desktop/)** — Deno launches a desktop runtime, catching 59 points and 11 comments on HN; a notable shift in the JavaScript runtime landscape.
- **[Danish privacy activist Lars Andersen raided by police](https://twitter.com/LarsAnders1620/status/2068208864747540516#m)** — The HN-leading story (116 points, 67 comments) raises serious concerns about surveillance and privacy rights in Europe.
- **Watch next:** Keep an eye on the Robotaxi scorecard showing China's dominance ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/21/techcrunch-mobility-a-new-robotaxi-scorecard-shows-chinas-dominance/)), the ongoing battle over AI agent security (payload smuggling), and the FDA's unanimous vote to approve Moderna's mRNA vaccine after agency drama ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/health/2026/06/fda-advisors-unanimously-vote-to-approve-modernas-mrna-after-agency-drama/)).

sports.zh:
2026年6月22日体育头条：世界杯冷门迭起，非洲新军佛得角逼平乌拉圭，埃及凭萨拉赫首胜；NBA进入休赛期交易潮，老鹰连签CJ-麦科勒姆及阿隆·维金斯；虎扑网友热议美国球场与巴萨绝杀；国羽在澳门赛豪取三冠一亚。

- **世界杯：佛得角续写黑马传奇**——世界杯新军佛得角0-0逼平两届冠军乌拉圭，以1分暂列小组第二，出线主动权在握 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c0qylwk421eo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))。埃及3-1胜新西兰，萨拉赫传射建功，获队史世界杯首胜 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/760452))。日本7-0狂胜后，中场鎌田大地重申“夺冠目标” ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49133799/daichi-kamada-reiterates-japan-goal-win-world-cup-record-win))。西班牙在拉明·亚马尔回归后3-0胜沙特，重回争冠轨道 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49136564/spain-lamine-yamal-back-resemble-world-cup-contenders))。葡萄牙小将孔塞桑称“没义务总传给C罗” ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49136209/no-obligation-pass-ronaldo-portugal-francisco-conceicao))。伊朗0-0平比利时，主帅称“在恶劣条件下踢出漂亮足球” ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49138797/iran-beautiful-game-belgium-worst-conditions-world-cup-2026))。伊拉克主帅开玩笑“想用三个门将防姆巴佩” ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49137803/iraq-coach-france-kylian-mbappe-3-goalkeepers-graham-arnold))。
- **NBA：尼克斯夺冠余波与交易潮**——尼克斯队史53年首冠游行后，老板多兰表态“不会用第二土豪线留人” ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49103460/james-dolan-go-second-apron-keep-knicks-intact))。老鹰连签CJ-麦科勒姆（1年2100万续约）([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49135921/cj-mccollum-stays-hawks-1-year-21m-extension)) 和交易阿隆·维金斯（付出两个次轮）([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49141113/hawks-set-land-guard-aaron-wiggins-thunder))。太阳续约乔丹·古德温3年1900万 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49135466/sources-suns-jordan-goodwin-set-3-year-19m-deal))。波普执行2160万球员选项留灰熊 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49120723/sources-caldwell-pope-opts-216-million-deal-grizzlies))。奇才特雷·杨拒绝4897万选项成自由球员，但仍可能留队 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49103130/sources-wizards-trae-young-decline-option-free-agent))。
- **虎扑热帖：巴萨绝杀、世界杯观感**——巴萨91分02秒绝杀皇马，凯西创近6年联赛最迟绝杀 ([虎扑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE4zeE4tSWZyNE9KaDYwdU9jNVgydXh6QkZ4RWhXWUI0b2Z1RjgtZDFEOVpSREdXbVVoX2w4UmdCcTVNYWdWMHVWR0hhXzRsNm9yUXlEdUNhUHl0ZUthcVFUZXlWcTE2UE5IdzJBVUtuU0R0Zw))。虎扑网友感叹美国球场修得好，话题“世界杯今日赛事神评”热度破万 ([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFA2ZVlGZkRDQVF2U2R5LVlldUJwLVJiMzR5ZTNWR2o4RHlPMnlXOWhqVjBFaFcwNmp6ME42RGVTX2FKWFBQNDA0R1dQQmgybFJXNWROTGxlakZ3dXpBYS1CS1RfX2NGZGh4c1hfYjVoNWoxRTc3OXMxbzVFT1Q))。
- **羽毛球：国羽澳门赛三冠，胡哲安崛起**——国羽在澳门公开赛获三冠一亚：胡哲安男单夺冠，蒋振邦/魏雅欣混双夺冠，女双包揽冠亚军 ([新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1KTkxEeFQ3WE45ek85QjhNNm96NXlhZ0xlX2gyQWJ5NkJtc3hwbDhQbHUzVHJUN0h0WW5Kc3ZadXVwWHU4T0FGM2o4SkJZN2dqYVY4Y0Q3ZEkzVWtJcks2cEtRYw))。新加坡公开赛出现争议判罚，马来西亚“乐蒂”组合申诉无效后强势逆转 ([Mshale](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBaaF9PZ2FaUzJGaENFX0d6Z1U3bUcxV28tU3JuN0NNSDhwMGt0MkE3ODJ0SmI2S2JpNFhWTXVic1NJRE5QZnlMMWNlV0c0b0cteU9SdXlOQmJHcVk))。

**后续观察**：世界杯小组赛第二轮即将开启，佛得角能否延续奇迹、日本能否兑现夺冠宣言值得关注。NBA自由市场本周正式打响，特雷·杨去向、尼克斯阵容调整将成为焦点。国羽年轻选手胡哲安在澳门夺冠后，需关注其后续高级别赛事表现。
sports.en:
The last 24 hours have delivered a whirlwind of action across the sports world, headlined by a series of stunning upsets at the 2026 FIFA World Cup and a flurry of NBA offseason moves. Cape Verde continued their fairy-tale run by holding Uruguay, while Egypt secured their first-ever World Cup victory thanks to Mohamed Salah. In the NBA, the champion Knicks celebrated their first title in 53 years, while teams like the Hawks and Suns reshaped their rosters. Meanwhile, Chinese badminton stars dominated in Macau and Singapore, and the HuPu community buzzed with reactions to the global sporting events.

- **Cape Verde's dream continues**: The debutants drew 1-1 with two-time champions Uruguay, keeping their knockout-round hopes alive in a result that ranks among the tournament's greatest shocks. [Source](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c0qylwk421eo)
- **Egypt makes history**: Mohamed Salah scored the go-ahead goal in a 3-1 win over New Zealand, giving Egypt their first World Cup victory 92 years after their debut. [Source](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c17yn5y977yo)
- **Iran holds Belgium in hostile conditions**: Despite a 0-0 draw that frustrated Belgium, Iran's coach praised his team's 'beautiful game' amid security controversies and a reported attempt by an IRGC-linked individual to board the team plane. [Source](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49138797/iran-beautiful-game-belgium-worst-conditions-world-cup-2026)
- **Japan sets sights on ultimate glory**: After a record-breaking win, Daichi Kamada reiterated Japan's goal to win the World Cup, signaling the team's arrival as a genuine contender. [Source](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49133799/daichi-kamada-reiterates-japan-goal-win-world-cup-record-win)
- **Spain rebounds with Lamine Yamal**: After a shaky start, Spain defeated Saudi Arabia and looked like a top team again, with teenager Lamine Yamal key to the revival. [Source](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49136564/spain-lamine-yamal-back-resemble-world-cup-contenders)
- **NBA offseason moves heat up**: The Hawks acquired Aaron Wiggins from the Thunder and extended CJ McCollum; the Suns re-signed Jordan Goodwin; Kentavious Caldwell-Pope opted in with the Grizzlies; Trae Young declined his option, while the Knicks' owner ruled out using the second apron to keep the championship core. [Source](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49141113/hawks-set-land-guard-aaron-wiggins-thunder) [Source](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49135921/cj-mccollum-stays-hawks-1-year-21m-extension)
- **Chinese badminton dominates**: At the Macau Open, Hu Zhe'an won the men's singles title and Jiang Zhenbang / Wei Yaxin triumphed in mixed doubles, while Chinese women's doubles pairs swept the podium. In Singapore, the 'Le Ti' pair overcame a controversial call to win. [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1KTkxEeFQ3WE45ek85QjhNNm96NXlhZ0xlX2gyQWJ5NkJtc3hwbDhQbHUzVHJUN0h0WW5Kc3ZadXVwWHU4T0FGM2o4SkJZN2dqYVY4Y0Q3ZEkzVWtJcks2cEtRYw) [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5tczhwNkFMcjJpTE1GSGJaWjAzNmpXOVhqcHhVaDVvZkR4eDVOMGthU1dvdkJ1anlyR082UVFEZkhfR0FhNVU4aXViUU1VTXhuLS1keFpQOVBzNXpvVXlRekxLbw)

**Watch next**: All eyes turn to Monday's World Cup match between Iraq and France, where Iraq's coach jokingly suggested playing three goalkeepers to stop Kylian Mbappé. In the NBA, free agency moves will continue with Trae Young's decision looming, while the Knicks' parade aftermath and Dolan's fiscal stance could impact roster construction. The Singapore Open badminton tournament continues with more upsets expected.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐头条呈现五大看点：**Kanye West遭圣安东尼奥市长公开抵制**，**Olivia Rodrigo登顶专辑榜**，**白玉兰奖场刊引发粉圈混战**，**BTS《ARIRANG》逆袭回榜**，**国际电影节跨文化交流升温**。后续需关注Kanye事件对七月演出市场的影响，以及白玉兰奖最终获奖者是否受舆论左右。

- 🎬 [Albert Serra与毕赣在上海电影节对谈：AI永远不会有天真](https://variety.com/2026/film/festivals/albert-serra-bi-gan-literary-adaptation-shanghai-1236786879/)——两位作者导演首次同台，从文学改编吵到AI创作，背后是中西电影市场对原创力的焦虑。
- 🚫 [圣安东尼奥市长要求取消侃爷7月4日演唱会](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/san-antonio-mayor-cancelation-kanye-west-july-4th-alamodome-1235581133/)——“军事城市不应资助仇恨言论”，市长援引城市资金设施条款，若取消成为先例，将冲击艺人演出保险与政治审查边界。
- 🎵 [Olivia Rodrigo第三张专辑空降Billboard冠军](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/olivia-rodrigo-number-one-album-chart-1235581149/)——击败Drake，创2026年单人歌手最高首周销量，情感叙事路线再度被市场验证。
- 📺 [《龙之家族》第三季首集水葬死亡戏](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/house-of-the-dragon-jace-dies-battle-gullet-season-3-premiere-1236783257/)——杰斯王子战死，演员透露水下睁眼拍摄挑战，该剧收视率预计将因核心角色死亡而分化。
- 🇫🇷 [动画《芭蕾之星》续集与剧集同步开发](https://deadline.com/2026/06/good-hero-expands-ballerina-universe-sequel-tv-series-1236963659/)——法国Good Hero公司趁原片十周年宣布宇宙扩张，Elle Fanning等原声阵容有望回归，暗示IP长线运营策略。
- 🇨🇳 [张颂文凭《纸盒藏迷》获上影节最佳男演员](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE5lVWVPNGR1bjJ6U2hCdjFYQlJUYzdSYWtoU2pQcWVER2ZUSVJRWG10WHNyUGNEUWNJVXVfa0ZTZVR4R2JsRDYwMDR1NDhNSm1xbjl2SWxsdjg)——继《狂飙》后再次斩获奖项，但该片尚未公映，市场关注票房转化。
- 🕵️ [《杀手的购物中心》第二季发布新剧照](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849429wpp/lee-dong-wook-kim-hye-joon-and-more-return-stronger-to-take-on-opposing-forces-in-a-shop-for-killers-2)——李栋旭、金慧埈回归，动作戏升级，Disney+韩国原创剧持续加码。

**后续观察**：Kanye事件若演化成演出合约法律战，可能推动美国演出合同新增“仇恨言论违约条款”；白玉兰场刊引发的粉丝拉踩已威胁奖项公信力，主办方需警惕审美疲劳；BTS回归前十表明韩流实体专辑长尾效应依然强劲，与Trafalgar在韩设子公司（收购HYBE资深人才）形成产业共振。
entertainment.en:
In the last 24 hours, the entertainment landscape has been defined by cross-cultural collaborations, franchise expansions, and a series of domestic and international award-season buzz. From the Shanghai International Film Festival to the Annecy Animation Festival, major industry moves signal a robust appetite for both highbrow debate and mass-market sequels. Meanwhile, K-pop and K-drama continue their global march, while Chinese social media churns with celebrity rivalries and viral moments.

- **Kanye West faces cancellation pressure** in San Antonio: Mayor Gina Ortiz Jones publicly called for the Alamodome to cancel his July 4th concert, citing his history of hate speech. This reflects ongoing corporate and civic backlash against controversial artists. [San Antonio Mayor Calls for Cancelation of Kanye West’s July 4th Alamodome Concert](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/san-antonio-mayor-cancelation-kanye-west-july-4th-alamodome-1235581133/)
- **Global animated hit 'Ballerina' (aka 'Leap!') gets a sequel and TV series**: Good Hero announced *Ballerina 2* and an animated TV series, expanding the universe a decade after the original release. This signals confidence in family-friendly IP with international appeal. [Ballerina 2 confirmed](https://variety.com/2026/film/global/ballerina-2-leap-film-sequel-tv-series-gaumint-good-hero-1236786872/) / [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/leap-sequel-greenlit-french-animated-ballerina-feature-1236626756/) / [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/good-hero-expands-ballerina-universe-sequel-tv-series-1236963659/)
- **'House of the Dragon' Season 3 premieres with a major death**: The episode killed off a key character in the Battle of the Gullet, sparking intense fan discussion. The actor described the underwater scene as 'challenging.' [House of the Dragon actor on watery death](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/house-of-the-dragon-jace-dies-battle-gullet-season-3-premiere-1236783257/)
- **Olivia Rodrigo scores third No. 1 album**: *You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love* beats Drake for the highest sales week of 2026 for a solo artist, cementing her status as a streaming-era powerhouse. [Olivia Rodrigo No. 1](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/olivia-rodrigo-number-one-album-chart-1235581149/)
- **BTS's 'ARIRANG' re-enters Billboard 200 top 10** three months after release, demonstrating the lasting global power of K-pop. Meanwhile, K-drama 'The Trauma Code' is in talks for multiple more seasons, and 'Reborn Rookie' breaks into double-digit ratings. [BTS Billboard](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849392wpp/btss-arirang-re-enters-top-10-of-billboard-200-3-months-after-its-release) / [Trauma Code](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849522wpp/the-trauma-code-heroes-on-call-in-talks-for-new-seasons)
- **China's White Magnolia Awards drama**: The festival program booklet's descriptions of Yang Mi and Yang Zi sparked fan wars over whose achievements are grander. Separately, Zhang Songwen won Best Actor at the Shanghai International Film Festival for *Paper Box Mystery*, while Dilraba Dilmurat stunned at the China Film Night red carpet. [Zhang Songwen wins](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE5lVWVPNGR1bjJ6U2hCdjFYQlJUYzdSYWtoU2pQcWVER2ZUSVJRWG10WHNyUGNEUWNJVXVfa0ZTZVR4R2JsRDYwMDR1NDhNSm1xbjl2SWxsdjg) / [Dilraba](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5NYjB2ck1UUl9KeHpSVFhTWEhORUJZYUFnU0lhS3lBWk9uMjhHR043NnFXLVE0dHBmbk5yYklaZDQtaVZGeFBKOUtYTEpLNTBCc0tBd3dxWGlVRTBhRFVpZm1qdW1GU2hQMXh0a2ZfaUFTdEYtR1BUTnNlMHVCZw)
- **Weibo trends oscillate between comedy and controversy**: Bai Lu and Wang Hedi's impromptu imitation goes viral, while Li Gengyun's frustrated post 'What else do you want?' draws sympathy. Jay Chou and Kunling's scooter ride also trended heartwarmingly. [Bai Lu/Wang Hedi](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNYndZZjJhWFFvM1FlYUtfXzUyTWg5dkdncjFBOGdGVllFaDViZ08tRlI3ZFRZSW1aZEtLUVUxSFFHVDlFMHJZZklKS3RpbUF0QVFZcnVuSXFsY1dyRjJNRjJPYk9Sa3owR0d1VFpwXzRPaUFVZDh6b1pSbjROOWpKUnROTE1ZYkREcWZ0Z0lIV2xBaHJ1c1oyZ1dBcTIwVHJFMmUtX0FrYkI) / [Li Gengyun](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE84Znl0VlJhd2xva0ljSWpWZ2RBNFpvUTNndmlLbWRBb0hVREVMZS1Nek1XZzRQNlJCbWlBTldjeEppNW9ZRjFuVGdkeVgyMDVpclFyMExoRUQtT2tJaTRHZjdndkhaVml5LWUwNU1OWmU)
- **Trafalgar Releasing launches Korean subsidiary** and poaches a Hybe veteran as Asia acquisitions head, signaling growing demand for event cinema in Asia, especially for K-pop concert films. [Trafalgar Korea](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/trafalgar-korea-launches-asia-acquisitions-hybe-1236786124/)

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on the fall-out from the Kanye West concert saga—could other cities follow San Antonio? Also monitor the Annecy Animation Festival for more franchise announcements; the 'Ballerina' expansion may trigger a wave of similar sequels. In Asia, 'The Trauma Code' return and BTS's continued chart longevity will shape K-content market perceptions. Domestically, the White Magnolia Awards ceremony (likely this weekend) will be a major TV event; fan wars are only intensifying.

美股.zh:
地缘政治与央行政策双线主导美股情绪。油价因美伊谈判进展而下跌，但特朗普对伊朗的军事威胁令能源板块波动加剧；同时英国首相斯塔默宣布辞职计划，增加欧洲政治不确定性。本周市场焦点转向美联储偏好的PCE通胀指标及FedEx财报，后者被视为运输与消费风向标。

- [Oil falls as Qatar, Pakistan announce 60-day roadmap for U.S.-Iran deal](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/22/oil-prices-wti-brent-crude-trump-iran-threat-strait-hormuz-closure.html) — 国际油价震荡，假日外交协议框架初现。
- [UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer set to outline exit plan as pressure to quit builds](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/22/keir-starmer-resign-uk-prime-minister-trump-andy-burnham.html) — 英国政坛再添变数，英镑承压。
- [Why Is FedEx in Focus as S&P 500 Transportation Trends Draw Attention?](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPT2xtU2JfNzVCZU1zZU1nVGIzYS1hSUdTeDdOd0ZvTzRhNGprM3ItX01jOEphZDh2dE9yNXVxSzJDMC14ZkxUREs4NHZrVnRKbS1lS1MwVDExWlAzVVdSNlphVWtUMFY2bE02VkZnVWk3cWhsNlFfWDc4QS1vdUE5Zlg4ZERMYktqWlJsbUotd2lpVTc2U2NMYTlSTlFENXF4R3pNaEVaWkxlSTNDaFZrV2l3) — FedEx财报将检验经济“软着陆”成色。
- [『Regime change but in a velvet glove』: How Kevin Warsh has set out to remake the Fed](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/21/how-kevin-warsh-has-set-out-to-remake-the-fed.html) — 美联储主席沃什的“天鹅绒革命”正悄然重塑央行决策框架。

美股短期受地缘风险和紧缩预期压制，但若PCE数据温和回落，可能为反弹提供催化剂。
美股.en:
U.S. equities faced a mixed open as oil’s plunge on a U.S.-Iran roadmap offset jitters from a hawkish Fed and escalating China-U.S. trade tensions. The Nikkei hit a record high overnight, but S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures edged lower. This week, investors will parse FedEx results and the PCE deflator for confirmation of the inflation trajectory.

- **Oil rout on Iran deal progress**: WTI and Brent fell sharply after Qatar and Pakistan brokered a 60-day roadmap. Iran’s foreign minister confirmed “major progress,” reducing the immediate risk of Strait of Hormuz disruption ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/22/oil-prices-wti-brent-crude-trump-iran-threat-strait-hormuz-closure.html); [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/22/business/oil-gas-price-iran.html)).
- **China retaliates with trade curbs**: Beijing imposed export controls and procurement exclusions on dozens of U.S. firms listed on the Pentagon’s 1260H blacklist. This escalates tech decoupling and adds uncertainty for U.S. semiconductor and defense supply chains ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/22/china-trade-curbs-us-companies-export-controls-procurement-exclusion-pentagon-list-.html)).
- **Fed in focus: Warsh’s revolution and PCE data**: Kevin Warsh is restructuring the Fed with task forces, signaling a potential shift in monetary orthodoxy ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/21/how-kevin-warsh-has-set-out-to-remake-the-fed.html)). Markets will also watch Friday’s PCE release; FedEx earnings provide a real-time check on corporate health ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/21/here-are-3-big-things-to-watch-in-the-stock-market-this-coming-week.html)).
- **Toy Story 5 sets box-office record**: Disney’s latest installment grossed $160 million domestically in its opening weekend, a positive signal for consumer spending and media stocks ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/21/pixar-toy-story-5-box-office-biggest-opening-in-franchise-history-.html)).

**Signal**: The combination of a U.S.-Iran détente and softening oil prices could ease inflation fears, but China’s trade retaliation and hawkish Fed rhetoric may keep the market range-bound. FedEx’s earnings will be the critical test of the real economy’s pulse.

中国经济.zh:
A股与港股走势分化。上证成交额突破3万亿元，钛白粉、金属等周期板块领涨，但港股在科技龙头拖下逼近熊市。政策面释放暖意：中国支持合格外资企业在境内上市，同时香港计划开放本地IPO给内地投资者并扩大科创板跨境渠道，旨在吸引流动性。房地产市场出现底部信号，但商业地产仍在承压。

- [China to back 'qualified' foreign firms for listing on domestic markets](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3357888/china-back-qualified-foreign-firms-listing-domestic-markets) — 扩大资本市场开放，吸引外资企业登陆A股。
- [Chinese Stocks in Hong Kong Near Bear Market After Holiday](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPay1kbHlGWGZtRC1vMFViS0dJRlVwZ0NXNnNGZm5pbGxYemRhd2lSSVl6YlkwMHFaZ2dKc1U0ZU53cEdHdzZWTl9mSnRoTEFhVWUtS201YUxWWWxfVUlpOGdfWllLREQzNGdQRmg1R3ZvMEJ1SHdKU0F6UUNiU0NNbmlxanNVNGVXOTJ2enI5SkRfekJ5YUVNbTF0cjZUbVIwNzVrcVlRVlEyMkFGcEE) — 恒生指数距熊市仅一步之遥，政策托底能否见效是关键。
- [Zhipu AI market cap tops HK$1 trillion as shares of GLM-5.2 developer soar](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3357858/zhipu-ai-market-cap-tops-hk1-trillion-shares-glm-52-developer-soar) — 智谱AI表现亮眼，成为AI概念新龙头。
- [Buyers hunt bargains amid signs that China's home prices are bottoming out](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3357835/buyers-hunt-bargains-amid-signs-chinas-home-prices-are-bottoming-out) — 上海等地二手房成交回暖，但买家心态仍偏谨慎。
- [Apple supplier Lingyi seeks US$1.1 billion Hong Kong IPO to fund AI and robotics push](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3357705/apple-supplier-lingyi-seeks-us11-billion-hong-kong-ipo-fund-ai-and-robotics-push) — 苹果产业链公司跨界AI机器人，IPO募资超80亿港元。

中国经济呈现“内热外冷”格局：A股交易活跃但港股信心脆弱，政策组合拳的落地效果仍待观察。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets displayed a stark divergence: A-share turnover surged past 3 trillion yuan while Hong Kong equities slid near bear-market territory. Beijing announced support for qualified foreign firms to list domestically, a move to internationalize its capital markets. The property sector shows tentative signs of bottoming, but commercial real estate faces tightening bank scrutiny.

- **China stocks near bear market; turnover spikes**: The Hang Seng index fell close to a 20% decline from its high, dragged by Alibaba and Xiaomi. Despite the slump, A-share daily turnover broke 3 trillion yuan, indicating active retail participation and possible accumulation ([Bloomberg](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPay1kbHlGWGZtRC1vMFViS0dJRlVwZ0NXNnNGZm5pbGxYemRhd2lSSVl6YlkwMHFaZ2dKc1U0ZU53cEdHdzZWTl9mSnRoTEFhVWUtS201YUxWWWxfVUlpOGdfWllLREQzNGdQRmg1R3ZvMEJ1SHdKU0F6UUNiU0NNbmlxanNVNGVXOTJ2enI5SkRfekJ5YUVNbTF0cjZUbVIwNzVrcVlRVlEyMkFGcEE)).
- **China backs foreign listings on domestic markets**: A new government circular will support qualified foreign-funded firms to list on A-shares and streamline M&A rules. This could attract global companies seeking yuan-based capital, but execution remains key ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3357888/china-back-qualified-foreign-firms-listing-domestic-markets)).
- **Property market: buyers hunt bargains, commercial pain deepens**: Homebuyers in Shanghai and other cities are sensing a price bottom after six years of declines, with some lived-in flats nearly halved from peak ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3357835/buyers-hunt-bargains-amid-signs-chinas-home-prices-are-bottoming-out)). Meanwhile, Yuzhou Group’s loss-making sale of Central office units shows banks are forcing writedowns ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3357811/hong-kongs-commercial-property-slump-enters-new-phase-lenders-take-tougher-stance)).
- **Zhipu AI surges to HK$1 trillion market cap**: The Chinese AI firm’s shares jumped up to 42% amid fervor for its GLM-5.2 model, underscoring the speculative reward attached to AI winners despite a weak broader market ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3357858/zhipu-ai-market-cap-tops-hk1-trillion-shares-glm-52-developer-soar)).

**Signal**: The divergence between A-share activity and Hong Kong weakness highlights a bifurcated market. Policy support for foreign listings could provide a catalyst, but the escalating trade war with the U.S. and property stress are persistent headwinds. Watch for further stimulus measures.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲股市普遍下跌，主因美联储鹰派表态压制风险偏好。巴克莱警告央行紧缩可能终结股市上涨势头。地缘政治方面，波兰首席经济学家直言德国经济需要“大胆革命性改革”，而英国脱欧十周年之际，经济困境引发反思。能源安全是另一主线：欧洲被警告将面临来自亚洲的激烈能源竞争，各国需准备“各自为战”。

- [European shares retreat as markets mull hawkish US Federal Reserve](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNODYwMzJGal94alJkSHIyVkNNMnlqVlo3OGYzNjZNOV9qM0lGdmNzQ0lBTUZuMFlaSGJvMFNSLUtBR25DUWE5clhNTnVNSjFPYVpTWGg3LTItdlREa1ZtYXE3Sm5lT2tjZXNkR1RENUp2dWxMU2RNOG14Q1FtSHR0dlVB) — 泛欧指数承压，市场担忧全球流动性收紧。
- [Barclays Warns Hawkish Central Banks Could Challenge Equity Market Momentum](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxObS05N1BNOXpRWlZKbC1BemNiUTVDUTd4ZzFnTDlYekhlWUhRY0F0OVRlNWIzR3N4b1p0cDIyY29xUzdoS3FyR05VeHRqeUExa3p2SjdpNVVHUF9qbFpNbnROS1JBeTFmaDV2WWNXSXo3MmstSHpVVzUwb3ViakU3aERfRHplcldQQzhkSHJpT0hmNU5pdlZGNUpUMElocDZOcGVF) — 巴克莱对股市持续性提出质疑。
- [Poland's Top Economist: Germany’s economy needs “bold revolutionary approach”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxOZjEzYmhUd1RFY3JpRGswVUwtVkd6cnNyVFJnSV82SWZ2dHh2OV92c0F1QjVwNWE4dmxCbTFYVGJGU2VMMHRNcDdBbmFvWGJ1TG9nVktmS2NVOTlhd3k5Z2Z2LURUM3RCbDRJZEVrRWFabWZEMFIwQ3pNOXUzY29Sdm16NktzbXU5dkhSOS04Y1dCeVFtc2xNY0YyWXVfalFpNlpRZ3lLWnEtUUIwb3UzdE9rQ3lVT2Ro) — 德国经济模式遭遇外部质疑，改革呼声再起。
- ['Every man for himself': Europe warned of rising competition for energy from Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOSmZOZWd1RWVlSXMzOW0xSUxfb1luWFV3UnQ5ZjhmT3pVYVpKdVluZ29TNjgwdGNQWjJ2OXBiMlJtY2kxcXpsc2JHNy1pQm5xWlZVQ3dnLWE2dWZFVmFqLU5fUGxXOV92am8tbVd5ajlqeHVRZ1JIT1NxUHZzdVo3aWd0ckd0NUtQNmdoRFQ0NjhlUDBNWHZKY3JCRmpzTnd6elpwcldOOUNiWENJQ2RpYw) — 能源竞争加剧，欧洲面临“丛林法则”考验。
- [Britain's economic woes fuel discontent with Brexit a decade after historic vote to leave EU](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPMFJLWEdBdG0wS1BSMEFnN1JTQm9PbnBpU1pDa3NDSWdGYTYtd2VRd3BMRng4dG4xc1JhYUI2SUdmZUcxOWR5SDhrT2pISng4RldXdF9OUGFCSVZQeGk0bUVleGhCTDFobGtLeDQ3ZXBMUk9QUngxdzR3bURrdHU0UUFNM2FrZ0UzNG04ZFozSFdlS0ZxZXpLSGxZYnFJYTR2cmYwbnhudlF2MHJsMXg4T1FR) — 脱欧十年，英国经济困境加剧社会不满。

欧洲股市短期受外部因素拖累，内部结构性问题（能源依赖、增长乏力）成为中长期隐忧。
欧洲经济.en:
European equities declined as markets digested a hawkish Fed tone and rising geopolitical risks from Asia. Defense stocks like Hensoldt are in focus as NATO spending commitments accelerate. Meanwhile, Britain’s Brexit discontent grows, and Poland’s top economist calls for a “bold revolutionary approach” to fix Germany’s economy. Energy competition from Asia is a new worry.

- **European shares dip on Fed concerns**: The Stoxx 600 lost ground as investors worried about the Fed’s tightening path. Barclays warned that global equity momentum could be challenged by coordinated central bank hawkishness ([AOL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNODYwMzJGal94alJkSHIyVkNNMnlqVlo3OGYzNjZNOV9qM0lGdmNzQ0lBTUZuMFlaSGJvMFNSLUtBR25DUWE5clhNTnVNSjFPYVpTWGg3LTItdlREa1ZtYXE3Sm5lT2tjZXNkR1RENUp2dWxMU2RNOG14Q1FtSHR0dlVB); [Yahoo Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxObS05N1BNOXpRWlZKbC1BemNiUTVDUTd4ZzFnTDlYekhlWUhRY0F0OVRlNWIzR3N4b1p0cDIyY29xUzdoS3FyR05VeHRqeUExa3p2SjdpNVVHUF9qbFpNbnROS1JBeTFmaDV2WWNXSXo3MmstSHpVVzUwb3ViakU3aERfRHplcldQQzhkSHJpT0hmNU5pdlZGNUpUMElocDZOcGVF)).
- **German defense stock Hensoldt in spotlight**: Morningstar analyzes whether Hensoldt can reclaim its record high as Europe boosts defense spending. The German sensor maker benefits from the security pivot, but valuation concerns remain ([Morningstar](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxQakstT1BYeVlNczF3OVB0WGh4aGRiS1NkQXJrWkY4eFVSZERyd3J5bEVtbWpFTlJuNGkzVXFLWUxkN05zeTdrNEhXbGhDU2tqQ2dzNVhmVVlzQWRjdkZpdldJWU5CNElWQ2NWUTA0ams1UzA1clY4SU9lRjJlUkw4TmRZM21YRlV6cDZuaFAxSnVxN1cxcl8wVnVGVWk5dmpkQnc)).
- **Brexit discontent resurfaces a decade on**: Britain’s economic struggles are fueling renewed public dissatisfaction with the Brexit vote. The UK faces slower growth and trade friction, while some analysts argue the country has inadvertently become “more European” ([ABC News](https://news.google.)).
- **Energy competition from Asia heats up**: Politico reports that European officials are warning of a “every man for himself” scramble for liquefied natural gas as Asian demand rebounds, threatening Europe’s energy security ([Politico](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOSmZOZWd1RWVlSXMzOW0xSUxfb1luWFV3UnQ5ZjhmT3pVYVpKdVluZ29TNjgwdGNQWjJ2OXBiMlJtY2kxcXpsc2JHNy1pQm5xWlZVQ3dnLWE2dWZFVmFqLU5fUGxXOV92am8tbVd5ajlqeHVRZ1JIT1NxUHZzdVo3aWd0ckd0NUtQNmdoRFQ0NjhlUDBNWHZKY3JCRmpzTnd6elpwcldOOUNiWENJQ2RpYw)).

**Signal**: European markets are caught between external hawkish monetary policy and internal structural challenges (Brexit, energy costs). Defense spending provides a bright spot, but the overall economic mood remains cautious. The ECB’s recent speeches on digital euro and central bank money signal long-term strategic shifts.

同花顺社区动态.zh:

- [散户大神出任董事长，银之杰20cm涨停，封单超8万手](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9fX0pQZnVyME1PSnhzaXY4Q203OWJQZUswbm82U1BTVlJqUV9feWxtY1FJblgxM3VvMkkwNVptTFRnUjlPSl9RY1RLMy14TXlBLXdyNVFnYmdxYXQxdWc) — 散户出任董事长引发情绪炒作，警惕追高风险。
- [“拍断大腿！”“20CM”直线涨停，封单超15万手](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5RanZ6eGRTYzBqNTdzaE5qMmVpZmFsaEI2Vk1pMkFZQktRejB6RkJLS3RPVTJyc3hRWFVGNWxQU0NuV3dHa2dxM0c3dTBpX05uVTdXTTVsY1ZOZHFhaEE) — 短线资金抢筹猛烈，次日溢价风险需留意。
- [金刚石散热概念火热， 多股大涨！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1CNVlQOGRaZDQ0UHYySkYyWjNyaXJkSnozU2RTWlFmd2VEd3QtSngwUGNaRUxPazJ4dWpJOEdaOTI2MFZqOERzbEN4OGRqU3M1LXU4d21EYVRoZDl1Umc) — 散热材料新题材获资金追捧，持续性存疑。
- [【股商异动】钛白粉板块异动大涨4.52%，龙佰集团金浦钛业领涨！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5sMmN0NTlqRDExNFlBa3d1ckI2dC1mcjM1dW1WcFJUR1NTOUVKS3BXVEwycExUQlRieGY3Zk1xYWZhRUFwOVpqYkhMZDlVM0pmdG5HajhNMXBYTUY2ZUE) — 周期板块异动，关注涨价逻辑是否延续。
- [科创信息等成立低空科技新公司](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5sMzA4Q3ZLT1lkRll6SUp3OHBvVzM4RHZMbkVVRjNXY19HVEhBWWNBMjdoYkRRWUhDXzFadDItODg2ZnFTOHQwM182V2hjb3hmSUVBY2NycVM3T3J4WGc) — 低空经济概念持续发酵，产业资本加速布局。

社区资金追逐新故事和情绪拐点，但题材轮动快、封单集中，散户参与需警惕流动性风险。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investors on the Tonghuashun platform reacted vigorously to a mix of A-share themes, with extreme moves in single stocks and sector surges. The appointment of a retail-investor-turned-chairman at Yinzhijie triggered a 20% limit-up, while concepts such as diamond heat-sinks and titanium dioxide saw broad gains. Sentiment remains speculative and momentum-driven.

- **'Retail investor god' becomes chairman, stock hits 20% limit-up**: Shares of Yinzhijie surged to the daily limit with over 80,000 lots in the buy queue after a well-known retail investor was appointed chairman. The story reflects the platform’s cult-like following of individual stockpickers ([Tonghuashun](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9fX0pQZnVyME1PSnhzaXY4Q203OWJQZUswbm82U1BTVlJqUV9feWxtY1FJblgxM3VvMkkwNVptTFRnUjlPSl9RY1RLMy14TXlBLXdyNVFnYmdxYXQxdWc)).
- **Diamond heat-sink concept catches fire**: Stocks tied to synthetic diamond thermal management materials soared, riding the AI hardware narrative. The move illustrates how new technology themes rapidly gain traction among retail traders ([Tonghuashun](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1CNVlQOGRaZDQ0UHYySkYyWjNyaXJkSnozU2RTWlFmd2VEd3QtSngwUGNaRUxPazJ4dWpJOEdaOTI2MFZqOERzbEN4OGRqU3M1LXU4d21EYVRoZDl1Umc)).
- **Titanium dioxide sector jumps 4.5%**: Led by Longbai Group and Jinpu Titanium, the chemical sector rallied. The move may be tied to raw material price expectations or policy support, though no clear catalyst was announced ([Tonghuashun](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5sMmN0NTlqRDExNFlBa3d1ckI2dC1mcjM1dW1WcFJUR1NTOUVKS3BXVEwycExUQlRieGY3Zk1xYWZhRUFwOVpqYkhMZDlVM0pmdG5HajhNMXBYTUY2ZUE)).
- **Insider selling: Nake Equipment executives plan to cash out ~300 million yuan**: While retail speculation heats up, insiders at some firms are taking profits, a cautionary signal for followers of the mobile-phone-driven momentum ([Tonghuashun](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5KSVN6ZXVPaWZ4SXBfd0tCa0lTVW02a0lESGk4M29nSk1IR3ZYMDBuLVNJRUdoWk1oLXd1cHZwRnIyS2M1TlNRUjBGcWJ6c0w4bXlZUDE2emI2WDl5REE)).

**Signal**: The Tonghuashun community is in full speculative mode, driven by new chairs, AI-linked concepts, and sector rotations. However, insider selling and the broader market weakness in Hong Kong suggest caution; retail euphoria may be peaking. Watch for regulatory comments on concept-driven trading.

欧美.zh: 俄乌战场进入关键节点：俄军夺取科斯强季尼夫卡的威胁[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9w2g0ewk95o)使乌东仅存堡垒陷入危机；乌方无人机袭击克里米亚补给线[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/22/crimea-halts-fuel-sales-after-ukraine-strikes-cause-shortages)引发民用汽油停售，显示攻击已波及平民生活。哥伦比亚总统决选中埃斯普里耶拉领先[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clye4ky2yzpo)，其主张重返全面军事对抗可能逆转2016年和平协议，冲突风险陡增。法国半数地区拉响红色高温警报[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/21/nx-s1-5862783/colombia-election-conflict)，街头音乐节禁酒，气候异常正直接改写公共生活规则。
欧美.en:
Conflict and social instability defined the European and American news landscape. The Ukraine war edges closer to a decisive phase, while Colombia's election signals a potential reversal of peace efforts. Domestic disruptions include France's extreme heatwave and Australia's housing slump, alongside a major cocaine bust in Sydney.

- **Ukraine**: Russian forces advance on Kostyantynivka, a gateway to Donbas strongholds ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9w2g0ewk95o)). Ukraine strikes cause Crimea to halt civilian fuel sales ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/22/crimea-halts-fuel-sales-after-ukraine-strikes-cause-shortages?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Colombia**: Abelardo de la Espriella wins presidential runoff, pledging full-scale military confrontation with armed groups. Rival calls preliminary count non-binding ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clye4ky2yzpo)).
- **France**: Red heat alert for half the country; alcohol banned at street music festival as temps may hit historic highs ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgmdw4vn7y2o)).
- **Australia**: Auction clearance rate drops to 47.4% – worst in six years ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/jun/22/auction-clearance-rates-six-year-low-australian-homes)). Largest cocaine bust (2.7 tonnes) in western Sydney ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c14ygjzr8j7o)).
- **US-Iran talks**: First round ends with 'encouraging progress'; 60-day timeline for final deal ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy0q41v1lzo)).

**Closing signal**: The confluence of war, climate extremes, and economic stress will keep these stories on the front burner.
